title: Add a contributor-guide glossary for process and lifecycle terminology
body:
### Problem Description

The contributor guide uses the words process and lifecycle without defining them. Readers new to desktop development would benefit from a short glossary. Example API names such as app.whenReady, BrowserWindow and session need no change; this request is solely about prose organization.

### Proposed Solution

Add glossary definitions and link to them from the guide. No API behavior or new API is requested.
